newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index slips 1.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index slips 1.5 pct.

text.p: LONDON, The Cazenove Indian GDR Index slipped 1.09 points, or 1.5 pct, to 71.57 points after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index lost 0.64 percent or 20.66 points to end at a provisional 3,230.26 points.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 9.21 percent after 11.48 percent on Thursday.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
